assets.name: Original beverage molds and label graphics V1
assets.author: OutOfService project
assets.license: Project-authored original work; no third-party packaging artwork imported
assets.use: Water, carbonated drinks, sports drinks, juice bottles and tea; 24 new parody labels
assets.modifications: Shared curved molds, transparent PET with retained specular, separate opaque liquid where appropriate, neck air gap, pressure feet, closure ridges, tamper groove and front/rear fitted print. Brands remain fictional.
